**Is this within scope?**

Check the non-goals in [spec §2.2](../../docs/REQUIREMENTS.md): CDC connectors,
outcome joins, reward computation, verifiers, training-set export and UI are
declared out of scope, and those are contractual rather than a backlog. A
proposal in that space needs to argue for reopening the boundary, not just for
the feature.
